entities.name: János Fuzik
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: János Fuzik was a Hungarian journalist and politician. A member of the National Self-Government of Slovakians in Hungary, he served as Ethnic Ombudsman of Slovaks in Hungary in the National Assembly from 2014 to 2018. In 2020, he was appointed Head of the Consulate General of Hungary in Esek.
